tldr: Sun in the 7th house: identity becomes personal through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
body:
With the Sun in the 7th house, this part of you develops through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to the one-to-one dynamics that show you how you meet others and how you let yourself be met.

When this placement is supported, relationship patterns can become clearer while there is still room to choose differently. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, you may hand too much power to the other person or make them carry the whole story. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
